verdict.rationale: Automated follow-up on overdue invoices is a fair question for a finance and payments platform. The evidence only covers Ramp's accounts-payable side: invoice intake, PO matching, coding, approval routing and paying vendors. Nothing documents automated reminders, dunning or collections on overdue invoices, and webhooks and AI agents are generic building blocks rather than this capability.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have overdue invoices automatically followed up on without manual chasing
